description:
Once you go under contract on a home, the lender and underwriters begin reviewing your financial documents.

During this time, it’s important to keep your finances stable.

Avoid things like:
• Opening new credit cards
• Making large purchases
• Changing jobs
• Moving money between accounts unnecessarily

Unexpected financial changes can raise questions and potentially delay your loan approval.

A trusted Central Texas Realtor will guide you through the process so everything stays smooth until closing.
